name: Transmuting
description:
Sneak right clicking an appropriate resource block attunes to it. Mining other appropriate blocks converts their drops into those of the attuned block at the equivalent exchange rate.

Pickaxes: All ores except Emerald and Ancient Debris.
Axes: All logs.
Shovels: Mycelium, Podzol, Clay, Red Sand, Soul Sand, and Mud.
Shears: All leaves.

For example, a Diamond sells for 8x as much as Raw Gold, so mining Gole Ore while attuned to Diamond Ore has a 1/8 chance to drop a diamond, while mining Diamond Ore while attuned to Gold Ore drops 8 Raw Gold.
